exact_static_inspection_b01_u10.root_cause_explanation: The 0.0001 mm3 value originated from segments=64 evaluation formatted to 4 decimal places (7.0966e-5 mm3). The 0.000009 mm3 value originated from 128-segment B-Rep solid evaluation (9.0e-6 mm3) inside AdaptiveTrajectoryValidator3D. Both values are numerical discretization artifacts strictly below the volume tolerance of 0.0001 mm3 (1e-4 mm3), confirming that the flange fits inside the AP1013 gooseneck recess without physical contact.
